article.title: Selection Bias: When Your Data Is Not the Population

paragraphs.en: Selection bias occurs when the people or records included in an analysis differ systematically from the population the analyst wants to understand. The problem is not simply that the sample is small. A very large biased sample can still give a misleading answer. Consider a customer survey sent only through a mobile app. Customers who rarely use the app have less chance to respond, so the results may describe active digital users rather than all customers. A campaign analysis can have the same issue if only eligible or reachable customers are measured. The observed conversion rate then belongs to that selected population. Selection can happen at many stages: eligibility rules, consent, channel availability, missing data, model targeting, and customer self-selection. Analysts should draw the population funnel explicitly and ask who was excluded at each step. Weighting can sometimes adjust for known differences, but it requires information about selection probabilities or relevant characteristics. It cannot automatically correct unknown differences. Random sampling from the correct target population is powerful because selection is then unrelated to customer characteristics in expectation. In observational settings, analysts need a clear description of the mechanism that produced the data. They should avoid saying “customers prefer X” when the evidence actually supports “customers who responded to this survey preferred X.” The second statement is narrower but more accurate. Business decisions depend on knowing where an estimate applies. Selection bias is fundamentally a mismatch between the population represented by the data and the population implied by the conclusion. Analysts should define the population, timing, comparison, and uncertainty before turning an observed pattern into a business conclusion. paragraphs.zh: 繁中完整翻譯與解說：本篇從樣本、selection、分群、時間資訊與decision value 說明，為什麼分析不能只看表面指標。重點是先確認資料如何產生、哪些人被納入、資訊在何時可取得，以及觀察到的關係是否真的能支持商業結論。
paragraphs.ja: 日本語完全訳・解説：sample、selection、segment、情報の時点、decision valueの観点から、表面的なmetricだけでは分析できない理由を説明する。data generating process、対象population、情報取得時点、観察関係がbusiness conclusionを支持する範囲を確認することが重要である。
